name: Blueprint
line: A pen plotter inks a part in the margin
description: A cyanotype theme for T3 Code. While your agent works, a pen plotter inks a part in the margin. When the turn ends, the sheet holds still.

name: Misprint
line: Two ink plates slip out of register
description: A two-ink print theme for T3 Code: fluoro pink and teal on cream stock. The inks slip out of register while your agent works and snap back when it stops.

name: Departures
line: A split-flap board rattles to BOARDING
description: A dark T3 Code theme in black, cream and amber. Flaps rattle while the agent works; the board reads BOARDING, then ON TIME.

name: Reel to Reel
line: VU needles bounce and the reels turn
description: A 1970s tape-deck theme for T3 Code. Walnut, brushed aluminium and amber VU meters. While your agent works the reels turn and the needles bounce; when it stops they settle.

name: Squiggle
line: Memphis confetti bobs and tumbles
description: A loud, light theme for T3 Code. Confetti, squiggles and terrazzo sit in the margins and start to bob and tumble while your agent works.

name: Molten
line: Wax lamps heat up and rise
description: A wax lamp theme for T3 Code. Deep violet glass, orange and magenta wax that drifts at idle and rises and merges while your agent works.

name: Marquee
line: House lights dim and the bulbs chase
description: A theatre-marquee theme for T3 Code. Oxblood velvet and gilt, with a bulb chase that runs while your agent works and house lights that dim when a turn starts.

name: Tilt
line: Pinball lights run and the score counts up
description: A pinball playfield theme for T3 Code. Idle runs a slow attract glow. While your agent works the inserts strobe, the ladder fills and the score reels tick. Done returns the ball to the lane.

name: Observatory
line: Star plates draw while a reticle tracks
description: A night observatory for T3 Code. A still star field sits behind the chat; while your agent works, a telescope reticle slews, locks on, and a constellation is traced.

name: Washi
line: Ink blooms, and a seal stamps at the end
description: A paper-and-sumi-ink theme for T3 Code. Ink blooms in the margin while your agent works; a hanko seal is pressed when the turn is done.

name: Sandgarden
line: A rake draws furrows around the stones
description: Sandgarden is a light theme for T3 Code. Raked sand, quiet stones, moss ink. A rake draws furrows in the margins while the agent works and settles into ripples when it stops.

name: Aurora
line: Curtains of light swell overhead
description: A polar night theme for T3 Code. Slow aurora curtains drift behind the chat, and brighten and ripple while your agent works.

name: Folio
line: E-paper dots fill in whole steps
description: Folio is a calm, greyscale reading theme for T3 Code. Warm paper, ink-black type, and a row of dots that fills while your agent works.

name: Fogbank
line: A lighthouse beam sweeps through mist
description: Fogbank is a calm, light theme for T3 Code. Pale grey-lilac fog drifts through the margins, and a lighthouse beam sweeps while your agent works.

name: Rainglass
line: Rain thickens on a night window
description: A rain-on-the-window theme for T3 Code. Slate-blue glass, a bokeh city, and droplets that slide down slowly at idle and more often while your agent works.

name: Darkroom
line: A print develops under the safelight
description: A red-safelight darkroom theme for T3 Code. While your agent works, a print develops in the tray and a timer counts. When the turn ends, the print is fixed and everything holds still.

name: Agar
line: Colonies grow on culture plates
description: A lab-culture theme for T3 Code. Notebook paper, amber agar and petri plates. While your agent works, colonies grow outward; at rest, everything holds still.

name: Clerestory
line: Stained glass kindles and light shafts cross
description: A stained-glass theme for T3 Code. The nave sits dim at rest; while your agent works, the windows kindle and shafts of light sweep across.

name: Primary
line: Bauhaus shapes recompose
description: A Bauhaus theme for T3 Code: paper, ink, red, yellow and blue. While your agent works, circles, squares and triangles rearrange into a new composition.

name: Phosphor
line: An oscilloscope traces Lissajous figures
description: An oscilloscope theme for T3 Code. A flat trace at rest; while your agent works, the scope draws Lissajous figures with a violet afterglow.

name: Contour
line: Map contours shift, and a pin drops at the end
description: A topographic survey theme for T3 Code. While your agent works the contours shift elevation; when the turn ends, a survey pin is driven into the summit.
